subject: Milestone-linked prepay + escrowed tranche proposal (Dedicated GPU)
messages:
From: Claire Thompson <claire@orbitsys.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor.huang@orbitsys.ai>, procure@orbitsys.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Milestone-linked prepay + escrowed tranche proposal (Dedicated GPU)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OrbitSys liked the latency profile and the predictable serving controls. We’re evaluating Redwood Dedicated for our inference fleet and would like to propose a multi-year structure that balances our cash flow with Redwood’s capacity planning. High-level proposal: 

- 3-year commitment, annual prepay (prepay at start of each contract year)
- Year 1: initial footprint 40 pGPU equivalents (25% of target capacity)
- Year 2: add +45 pGPU (total 85) contingent on integration milestone (production traffic >= 5M daily infer ops for 30 days)
- Year 3: add +45 pGPU (total 130) contingent on adoption milestone (sustained utilization >= 60% for 90 days)
- We’d like a step-up term discount tied to realized commitment: 6% off list if we hit Year 2 milestone, 12% off list if Year 3 milestone achieved.

Because our CFO needs protection for a three-year prepay, we’re open to an escrow arrangement for the undrawn portion with staged release (e.g., partial release on onboarding, remainder on milestone). We’ve attached a short PDF that outlines our requested structure and procurement timeline (OS_Redwood_MultiYear_Request_v1.pdf).

Would Redwood consider: a modest headroom discount today (3–5%) combined with milestone-triggered additional discounts and an escrow holdback for year-2/year-3 prepay amounts? If you can share a modeled pricing scenarios workbook, that would help speed internal approvals.

Best,
Claire
Claire Thompson
Head of Cloud Procurement, OrbitSys
procure@orbitsys.ai

Attachments: OS_Redwood_MultiYear_Request_v1.pdf (1 page)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@orbitsys.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Milestone-linked prepay + escrowed tranche proposal (Dedicated GPU)

Claire — thanks for the clear proposal and the timeline. We’re keen to make a structure that matches OrbitSys’s cash protection needs but also keeps capacity planning simple for us. A couple of quick points and options we can model: 

Option A — Simplified annual prepay: flat prepay each year, 10% term discount applied after year1 signature for full 3-year commit. No escrow. Easier to contract, faster procurement.

Option B — Milestone-linked escrow (your ask): initial prepay covers Year 1 footprint (40 pGPUs). Year 2/3 prepayments can be held in escrow and released on milestone attainment. Discount ladder: 3% immediate, additional 6% at Year2 milestone, +6% at Year3 milestone (total up to 15%). Escrow admin fees are typically shared.

Option C — Amortized accelerator credits: OrbitSys prepays full three years upfront at a modest uplift; we amortize the prepay and provide quarterly accelerator credits that increase if you hit adoption targets (less legal work than an escrow).

I’ve asked Rishi and Marissa to run numbers and produce a pricing scenarios workbook — you should see a Redwood workbook attached from us (Dedicated_Pricing_Scenarios_v2.xlsx) by tomorrow. Can we schedule a 30-min procurement/pricing call Thursday 29 Jan to walk the scenarios and agree on milestone definitions?

I’ll also loop Finance for the escrow mechanics — Marissa and Rishi are on this thread.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Dedicated_Pricing_Scenarios_v2.xlsx (workbook)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 09:32:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: recommend escrow cadence + amortization approach (re: OrbitSys)

Team — quick internal note before we send the workbook to OrbitSys: 

- I think Option B (escrow) reduces OrbitSys friction but adds legal/ops overhead for us. Option C (amortized accelerator credits) is lower ops but may reduce perceived buyer protection.
- Proposal: offer a hybrid — escrow hold for the Year2/3 prepaid cash but with a predefined rapid-dispute-release clause and capped admin fee; pair with accelerator credits that are paid monthly if adoption thresholds are exceeded.
- Escrow release schedule suggestion: 30% at contract signature (to fund onboarding), 40% on onboarding SLO acceptance (SLA thresholds met in staging + 2 weeks of prod smoke), remaining 30% released on milestone attainment.
- Pricing tweaks: base term discount 4% at signature, incremental 6% and 8% for hitting Year2/Year3 milestones respectively (total 18% if all achieved). This matches our margin targets while giving OrbitSys strong upside for adoption.

I’ve attached a quick finance model showing cashflow and revenue recognition impact (Finance_Amortization_Model.xlsx). Priyom — can you check the revenue recognition and suggest any wording we should avoid in the term sheet? Rishi/Marissa please sanity-check the percent bands before I send.

—Lauren

Attachments: Finance_Amortization_Model.xlsx
From: Claire Thompson <claire@orbitsys.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor.huang@orbitsys.ai>, procure@orbitsys.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Jan 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Milestone-linked prepay + escrowed tranche proposal (Dedicated GPU)

Lauren — appreciate the fast turnaround and the hybrid suggestion. A couple of counterpoints from procurement/finance: 

- Escrow is acceptable only if the admin fees are <1.5% and we have a clear dispute resolution SLA (5 business days).
- OrbitSys would prefer the escrow to cover only the undrawn Year2/Year3 prepay amounts (not Year1).
- In lieu of a large upfront discount, we’d be willing to commit to the 3-year profile if Redwood can guarantee a 10% blended discount at full 130 pGPU scale (after Year3 onboarding). If Redwood needs the staged ladder, we can agree to the ladder as long as the blended outcome equals ~10%.

We’d like Redwood to prepare a draft term sheet and a short SOW we can feed into our legal. If possible, avoid escrow language that creates indefinite holds — we need a maximum 12-month automatic release if milestones aren’t met (so funds don’t sit indefinitely).

Can we take the hybrid you suggested and produce a TermSheet v0.3 with the release cadence and a 12-month auto-release clause? Our procurement team is available for a call Thursday 29 Jan 10am PT.

Thanks — will loop Victor (technical lead) on the call to confirm onboarding SLOs.

Best,
Claire

Attachments: none
From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@orbitsys.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Milestone-linked prepay + escrowed tranche proposal (Dedicated GPU)

Claire — agreed, we can do the hybrid with the constraints you listed. Next steps: 

1) Redwood will publish OS_Redwood_TermSheet_v0.3.pdf with the escrow release cadence (30/40/30 split), a 12-month auto-release, and an outlined blended discount target.
2) Legal sync: Thu 29 Jan 10:00am PT (30 min) — please share a calendar invite; Victor and your procurement team are expected.
3) Pricing call: Thu 29 Jan 10:30am PT (follow-on, 30 min) to walk the Dedicated_Pricing_Scenarios_v2.xlsx assumptions.

I’ve attached the TermSheet v0.3 draft for your intake. We’ll also prepare a short SOW after the legal sync. Looking forward to the call.

—Lauren

Attachments: OS_Redwood_TermSheet_v0.3.pdf
From: Claire Thompson <claire@orbitsys.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor.huang@orbitsys.ai>, procure@orbitsys.ai
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Milestone-linked prepay + escrowed tranche proposal (Dedicated GPU)

Lauren — confirmed for Thu 29 Jan meetings (we have calendar holds). Our procurement team reviewed the TermSheet v0.3 and likes the 12-month auto-release language. Two minor asks before legal signs off: 

- Can Redwood add an explicit cap on escrow admin fees (0.75% per annum) in the term sheet?
- For the blended discount calculation, please include an example row showing Year1/Year2/Year3 prepay amounts and the blended effective discount at the 130-pGPU target.

If you can email updated TermSheet v0.4 with those items, we can route to CFO for signature next week. Thanks for being flexible on the hybrid approach — OrbitSys is ready to move quickly once the term sheet has those clarifications.

Best,
Claire

Attachments: none
